ios.desc:
Your health data in your control. Export and share your Apple Health information in seconds.

vitalina makes it easy to export your health data from Apple Health and share it with your doctor, keep personal records, or use it however you need.  Whether you're managing a chronic condition, preparing for a medical appointment, or simply want a backup of your health information - vitalina has you covered.

EXPORT WHAT MATTERS TO YOU 
• Heart rate & blood pressure 
• Blood oxygen & respiratory rate 
• Steps, distance & flights climbed 
• Active & resting energy 
• Sleep analysis with complete stage breakdown 
• Workouts with detailed metrics 
• Weight & body measurements 
• And more...


MULTIPLE FORMATS
• PDF - Perfect for sharing with healthcare providers 
• CSV - Open in Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers 
• JSON - For developers and custom analysis


FLEXIBLE TIME RANGES 
Export data from the last 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, or select a custom date range. Get exactly the data you need, nothing more.


PRIVACY FIRST
Your health data never leaves your device. vitalina processes everything locally. No accounts, no cloud uploads, no data collection. What happens on your iPhone stays on your iPhone.


vitalina is a data export tool only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations. Always consult with a qualified healthcare provider for medical guidance.

Payment charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
